title: Expected value over random restrictions
statement: For a natural number $n$, a real parameter $\delta$, and a real-valued function $g$ that assigns a value to each subset $J\subseteq\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$ and each sign assignment $z$ on its complement, define the expected value over random restrictions as $\sum_{J\subseteq\{0,\ldots,n-1\}}\delta^{|J|}(1-\delta)^{n-|J|}\,\mathbb{E}_{z}[g(J,z)]$, where the expectation is over sign assignments on the complement of $J$.
hypotheses_covered: $g(J,z)$ is real-valued for each subset $J$ and sign assignment on its complement
